_comment: Exp 44 (NEW numbering, founder 20 July + roadmap approval 26 July) — EVIDENCE LAYER review + SHAKE-OUT of the Exp 43 contested-convergence fixes. Target bench/evidence.py (641 lines, ~23K chars, 31 AST symbols): the semantic query/provenance layer over the VerificationChain (cryptographic accountability memory). PURPOSE: (1) the discriminating post-fix convergence test — evidence.py is size-matched to the 22K class where the contested artifact actually blocked Exp 43, so a clean two-sided-gate convergence here attributes to FIX 1-5, not target ease; (2) a genuine review of a meaningful dormant module destined for the accountability UX. INSTRUMENT IDENTICAL to the Exp 42/43 landmarks (single fixed runner, CONFIRM-only falsifier gate, capability-aware routing, code-location novelty key, two-sided gamma gate, domain=software) EXCEPT the four DECLARED deltas: (a) FIX 1 — contested_count excludes un-demonstrated sub-critical findings (C0013/C0040 class), surfaced in a non-gating residual queue; (b) FIX 2 — falsifier-ERROR findings of any severity are routed ONCE to a stronger writer; (c) FIX 3 — parser fallback no longer registers registry-referential prose (review summaries) as findings; (d) FIX 4 — max_contested_rounds 5 -> 3. FIX 5 (residual-clearing panel duty) rides the gated falsifier directive. domain stays 'software' deliberately: one variable at a time — the fixes are this run's change; the statistics-specialist domain switch is Exp 45's declared change. gamma is LOAD-BEARING (standing directive 2026-06-10): converged iff gamma_critical >= 0.30 AND 3 consecutive zero-new-critical rounds (location-keyed, settled series), plus A4 fail-safe, not-contested, not-churning, irreducible queue within bound.
_stall_gamma_note: Stall-path gamma thresholds set above the gamma ceiling (1.0) so the stall detector can never fire via gamma — convergence rests on the two-sided gamma-alt gate. Config-level guard, identical to Exp 42/43.
_max_contested_rounds_note: FIX 4 (declared delta, 2026-07-22): lowered from the code default 5. Five rounds of paid compute to age out a churning residual was both wasteful and, against within-grace churn, ineffective (Exp 43). With FIX 1 in place sub-criticals no longer block, so this threshold now governs only genuinely contested items.
_test_cmd_note: Evidence-layer regression guard (sandbox, informational — apply_fixes_back_enabled=false, static review).

_convergence_criteria.description: TWO-SIDED GATE (founder ruling 2026-06-10; hardened_gate_enabled=false). gamma is ACTIVE and LOAD-BEARING. Converged iff ALL of: (1) gamma_critical >= 0.30 on the location-keyed critical series; AND (2) 3 consecutive rounds with zero NEW genuine critical (settled/verifier-filtered, location-keyed); AND (3) no unverified critical candidate pending (A4 fail-safe); AND (4) not contested — where, per FIX 1, un-demonstrated sub-critical findings are a logged NON-GATING residual queue; AND (5) not churning; AND (6) irreducible queue within bound.
_convergence_criteria.pass_condition: gamma_critical >= 0.30 AND 3 consecutive zero-NEW-genuine-critical rounds AND no unverified critical pending AND not contested (FIX-1 semantics) AND not churning AND irreducible queue within bound.
_convergence_criteria.fail_condition: Any model fails to produce parseable output in 2+ consecutive rounds; OR non-convergence (then assume MECHANICAL, diagnose under cy — do not demote gamma).

_directives_live._section_10_note: A4 (12 July 2026): section 10 was established INERT — the flag never reaches RunnerConfig and no compelled-convergence text reaches dispatch. Recorded false here for documentation accuracy; behaviourally identical to Exp 42/43, whose configs carried a stale 'true'.

_pre_registration: Frozen 2026-07-22 before the run. Exp 44 = the post-fix shake-out on bench/evidence.py under the instrument-identical two-sided gate, with exactly five declared deltas (FIX 1, 2, 3 in code; FIX 4 in this config; FIX 5 in the gated directive). PREDICTION: the run converges cleanly within the round budget (sy replay of Exp 43 data says the FIX-1 gate closes at the first 3-zero streak, ~R6-R8 expected here), with zero sub-critical contested blocking, the residual queue explicitly logged, and low/zero residual HIL. FAILURE MODES to report honestly: (a) does not converge -> assume MECHANICAL, diagnose under cy, do NOT demote gamma; (b) converges but the post-run HIL materiality review finds a genuine defect parked in the residual queue that should have gated -> FIX 1's severity boundary or falsifier-verdict test is mis-drawn, revisit before Exp 45; (c) contested still blocks -> FIX 1 mis-implemented or a new contested pathway exists. No tuning after results. z3 invariant carried: FIX 1 can never pass a critical-contested finding.
_plan_ref: NEW Exp 44 (roadmap approved by founder 26 July 2026: forensic roadmap, 6-experiment compressed arc). Runner: reference_runner_v3.py with the 2026-07-22 fix tranche. Next: Exp 45 = dm/_memory.py with domain=statistics (declared specialist variable).
_locationkey_note: location_keyed_convergence=true keys the per-round NEW-critical count by which evidence.py symbol each critical names (AST-extracted, 31 target symbols), not by model-chosen finding-id — the instrument proven on Exp 42 (converged R6) and generalised on Exp 43.
